title: 09-23 upload SP-b5
description: One sim-pretrained b5 SimVP backbone in fp32, prior and energy net refitted, conditional widths (W2 fit). Execution changes of that day: window-0/1 CUDA graphs, kernel diet, fp16 width net in the whole-step graph, convection scan on windows 0-1 only. No CB or per-trajectory choices.

dry_run.final_submission/realpde: resolves; its step-10 package source (2026-10-06) is not in this repository, so train_preset.sh runs the weight steps 01-09 only

fidelity.why: With the final weights this runs the 3-member ensemble in TF32 instead of one fp32 backbone. With b5sp weights the CONFIG equals the 2026-10-06 source's; the weights are a retrain.
